answered_on_site.question: What does pediatric dentistry include?
answered_on_site.answer_summary: Pediatric dentistry includes applying protective sealants to molars and administering direct fluoride treatments to strengthen tooth enamel against decay.
answered_on_site.evidence_quote: Pediatric dentistry includes using sealants to help prevent cavities and tooth decay on a child’s back molars.

answered_on_site.question: What is IV sedation dentistry?
answered_on_site.answer_summary: IV sedation involves administering a sedative through an intravenous line, allowing real-time adjustment to keep patients relaxed during procedures.
answered_on_site.evidence_quote: IV sedation dentistry, also known as sleep dentistry, involves administering a sedative through an intravenous line.
